title: Research: independently verify the 73-map two-transfer exclusion
body:
## Summary

PR2208 explicitly leaves its 73-map/two-transfer connector exclusion with one census implementation. This adds a separate standard-library checker and exhaustive coverage proof for both exceptional multiplicities.

```text
restoring word -> first transfer -> two source phases
  -> solve restoring physical ports -> all paired/triple reads
  -> every native histogram bin = (12 or 13) * new bin
```

Only `research/connector-two-transfer-audit/` is added. Conorholds' theorem and tariff remain credited. No new kappa, physical caller or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the published 73-map exclusion has one native implementation.
  **After:** 145,080 paired-source and 1,401,120 triple-source assignments independently exclude both cases. Every scaled histogram bin agrees with PR2208; its two original native domains were also freshly replayed.
- The complete small oracle checks 116,400 port assignments, both orientations, all 2,796 restoring cases and every two/three-read mask. Four complete words pass 552 dirty forward/inverse pairs; all 356 omission/port/direction variants reject.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, three behavioral groups, broad pinned Ruff diagnostics, committed-byte/source-history checks and optimized Git-free replays pass. Exact inputs, commands, limits and controls are in README.md, PROOF.md, VALIDATION.md and the two receipts.
- [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2049#discussioncomment-19009368). Scientific base remains canonical `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` after submission refresh. Unequal prices, physical admission, formal-kernel and independent human review remain unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

Self-contained research verification only. Frozen predecessors, selected sources and shared tooling are unchanged.
